text:
incident-bot: Planned serving evacuation in eu-west1 tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC. This is a graceful node drain to apply kernel/security patches on a subset of serving hosts. Expected customer impact: minimal; connections will be drained and rerouted. Posting draft statuspage + customer notice below — please review and flag ASAP if any objections. @oncall please coordinate handoff and monitor route-failover metrics.

liz_h: ack — thanks for the heads up. can we confirm which model shards/pools are in the affected pool? need to check Dedicated reservations.

samir: affected pool = eu-west1-serving-pool-b (approx 6 nodes). Model shards: rwd-gt-13b-v3 & rwd-quant-7b. Dedicated customers pinned to those nodes will be migrated to fallback capacity (eu-west1-serving-pool-a) during drain.

marta_cs: sharing customer-facing snippet for review. customers with pinned Dedicated capacity should get an email that mentions no code changes required and potential transient rate-limits. please include SLA pointer.

ops_runbook: runbook items for oncall during the window:
1) Pre-check at T-1h: validate autoscaler health + routing table.
2) Start drain (safe-drain script): `./safe-drain --pool eu-west1-serving-pool-b --grace 300`
3) Watch metrics: prefix-hit-rate, kvcache hit, tail_latency_p50/p95, connection_drops.
4) If errors spike > 10% baseline for 10m -> abort drain and roll back traffic.
5) Post-drain verify: traffic distribution, token-cost delta, and run customer smoke tests.

oncall-roster-bot: Assigning primary oncall: samir, secondary: liz_h. Paging policy: page primary immediately on critical pager; notify secondary via @channel for visibility.

liz_h: quick note on comms wording — change "minimal" to "possible transient 5–10% increased latency for short bursts". customers appreciate clarity. also add explicit rollback path in the notice.

incident-bot: statuspage draft: 
---
Scheduled maintenance: eu-west1 serving node update
Start: 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC
End: 2026-05-12 04:00 UTC (estimated)
Impact: Services will be routed to fallback capacity during maintenance. Customers may see short bursts of increased latency; no customer data will be affected.
Rollback: If performance regressions exceed thresholds, traffic will be restored to pre-maintain assignments and maintenance postponed.
---
Please review and suggest edits.

marta_cs: customer email draft below — feel free to copy/paste into Help Center: 
"Hello — We're scheduling a brief maintenance window in eu-west1 to apply security patches to serving hosts on 12 May 2026, 02:00–04:00 UTC. During this time requests may be routed to alternative capacity causing short latency spikes for a small fraction of requests. No customer action required. If you have dedicated reservations pinned to eu-west1-serving-pool-b and require a maintenance freeze, reply to this message and we will coordinate a custom window. For full details and SLA info see: https://status.redwood.example/incident/3278901234"

samir: timeline note — we'll run a small canary drain at 02:00 for 20 minutes (2 nodes), then proceed if metrics stable. canary failure criteria: error-rate > 2x baseline or p95 > baseline + 50ms sustained 5m.

liz_h: i updated the statuspage wording to include the latency band and rollback line. Also added a short Ops contact block.

ops_runbook: I pushed the runbook into the ops handbook: https://handbook.redwood.example/ops/runbooks/eu-west1-maint-3278901234 (internal). Please do a quick read before shift.

oncall-roster-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff at 01:30 UTC. If primary cannot attend, update the roster now.

marta_cs: scheduled customer email queued. Will hold send until final confirmation at T-30m.

samir: prepping drain script and smoke tests now. tagging @liz_h when ready.

liz_h: thanks, will be online for the canary and full drain.

incident-bot: maintenance job created in scheduler (id: maint-3278901234). Notifications will be sent to the incident channel and statuspage at T-60m and T-15m.

marta_cs: thanks everyone — if no objections by EOD we'll mark this as announced and send the T-60m customer notice. :thumbsup:
